theirReference: Cristian is a super kind host. Even before we arrived, he already sent us tips about places to visit and food to eat. He welcomed us and let us sleep in after a red-eye flight which was highly appreciated. We get to have our own room and a comfortable bathroom to use. His mum shared food with us, which made us feel so welcomed. We also hanged out with Cristian and his girlfriend, and he showed us his favourite places to get food, which was super cool. Cristian is very thoughtful and he has organised the room for couchsurfers in a very clear and friendly way. Highly recommended. Cristian, all the best with your future travels! Our visit to Bogotá wouldn’t have been the same without you!
myReference: I had the pleasure of hosting Emily and her husband in Bogotá, and it was a truly wonderful experience. We went out for a walk together and enjoyed exploring Colombian gastronomy — they even tried chicha, a traditional local drink! They also prepared a delicious Asian dish that I really enjoyed. Both of them are very respectful, clean, organized, and incredibly kind. They are open-minded, polite, and easy to get along with. I definitely recommend them to any host or traveler and would be happy to meet them again in the future! Enjoy South America guys 🤗 anytime you wanna come back you are more than welcome ✨

theirReference: Christian and Alondra were incredibly kind and welcomed me with so much warmth from the moment I arrived. They showed me around Bogotá, taking me not only to the popular spots but also to local places I would never have found on my own. Because of them, I was able to experience the city in a deeper and more authentic way, and it truly made my trip unforgettable. Christian’s mother was also very sweet and treated me like part of the family. She even made delicious tea for me during my stay, and her kindness left a strong impression on me. Their home has such a warm and comforting atmosphere. They also have a German Shepherd who was absolutely adorable — friendly, playful, and such a joy to be around. Spending time with him made my stay even better. I truly hope I can meet Christian and Alondra again someday in Ecuador. They are not only wonderful hosts but also genuinely good-hearted people who made my experience in Bogotá very special. I highly recommend staying with them to any traveler visiting the city.
myReference: Yusuke and Kanami are a truly wonderful couple, and hosting them was an absolute pleasure from beginning to end. They brought a very warm and positive energy into the home, and every interaction with them felt natural and enjoyable. They were always very clean, organized, and respectful of the space, which made their stay incredibly easy and comfortable. 😇 What stood out the most was their genuine interest in learning about the local culture and their enthusiasm for exploring the city. They asked thoughtful questions, shared stories about Japan, and showed a sincere curiosity that made every conversation enriching. As a thoughtful gesture, they even gave me a coin from their country for my collection, which I truly appreciated. ⭐️ Their kindness, openness, and positive spirit make them people you instantly feel comfortable around. I completely and wholeheartedly recommend hosting them. Any future host will be lucky to welcome such a considerate, friendly, and inspiring couple. 😁
